messages:
Priya (CS): Mandarin Health just flagged their renewal invoice — looks like platform fee and support tier billing don't match. attaching screenshot.

Marco (Acct Mgmt): Can you drop the invoice number and attachment? I'll pull the contract.

Priya (CS): Invoice INV-2026-045. PDF page 2 shows: 
```
Line 1: Private Deployment Platform Fee - $55,000 (monthly)
Line 2: Premier Support (1yr) - $12,000
Line 3: One-time migration surcharge - $5,000
```
Contract shows platform fee should be $35,000/month (we offered a promotional rate during pilot) and support should be Enterprise (they paid for upgrade at renewal in contract). Customer is upset; wants immediate credit and corrected invoice.

Marco (Acct Mgmt): Ok—looks like billing imported the old list price. @Diego can you check metering/subscription snapshot for subscription S-98765?

Diego (RevOps): Pulling S-98765...subscription renewal date 2026-04-01. Metering snapshot shows platform_fee_rate_msat: 35000 and system shows invoice line used rate 55000. That's a rate override bug in the ingestion job 'private-rate-sync' from 2026-03-18. Repro steps: ingest job picks price_id=legacy:pd:list instead of contract.price_id.

Ava (Finance): Ugh. That explains the overshoot. How big is the delta for the bill period? rough calc: (55k-35k) = 20k * 1 month = 20k. With support mismatch add 12k expected vs 0? But invoice shows Premier $12k—contract should be Enterprise $18k so additional 6k. Net customer overcharged around $26k. Need credit approval >$25k — our policy requires finance manager sign-off.

Sasha (Sales): We have the signed amendment for Enterprise support on 2026-02-15. @Marco please attach signed PDF to the Jira ticket.

Marco (Acct Mgmt): Created billing ticket BILL-4521 and attached contract + invoice. Requesting one-time credit for $26,000 and reissue invoice. @Ava please approve so we can issue credit memo. tagging: :eyes:

Ava (Finance): Approving $26,000 credit memo on the condition we reconcile the ingestion job and patch before next run. I'll escalate to Finance Director for visibility but this can go ahead. Approver: Ava (finance manager).

invoices-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-078 created for INV-2026-045 with amount $26,000. Affected invoice voided and reissue pending.

Priya (CS): Great — customer notified, asked for ETA on corrected invoice. Marco please send reissue ETA to customer.

Marco (Acct Mgmt): Will send reissued invoice ETA by EOD tomorrow and cc finance. Thanks everyone.
